vulnerability_analysis: The CoinToken contract has an owner-only function enableBlacklist() that can blacklist any address. Once blacklisted, addresses cannot send or receive tokens. This demonstrates excessive owner privilege where the owner can arbitrarily restrict any address from using the token.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call enableBlacklist() to blacklist the attacker's address, then verify the blacklist status.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call enableBlacklist(attacker) on the target contract. 4. Verify that isBlacklisted(attacker) returns true.
